    A presentation on two-term projective representatives #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_block_presentation (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (T Y : TwoTerm R) (ht : T.IsPresilting) (hgen : ∀ (X : TwoTerm R), T.InThick X) (hy : Function.Surjective ⇑(T.homotopyBoundary Y)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (w : Y.source ⟶ (T.copies n).target), IsInAdd ((T.copies n).blockExtension Y w).homotopyObject T.homotopyObject

    Enlarge the first term of the silting presentation to a finite sum of copies of T. The new middle term is an actual block extension in add(T), and its projective class is the sum of the two end classes.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_biprod_presentation (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (T Y V : TwoTerm R) (ht : T.IsPresilting) (hgen : ∀ (X : TwoTerm R), T.InThick X) (hy : Function.Surjective ⇑(T.homotopyBoundary Y)) (hv : IsInAdd V.homotopyObject T.homotopyObject) (hc : Y.projectiveClass = V.projectiveClass) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ), let W := (T.copies n).homotopyObject; ∃ (i : W ⟶ W ⊞ V.homotopyObject) (p : W ⊞ V.homotopyObject ⟶ Y.homotopyObject) (δ : Y.homotopyObject ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) 1).obj W), CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk i p δ ∈ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles

    When V in add(T) has the class of Y, the presentation has middle term isomorphic to W ⊕ V for a finite sum W of copies of T.
